源码保留在仓库；数据根目录由参数显式指定。原始响应、采集清单、修正依据和版本化结果分别保存。
本报告验证持久化结算库、原始采集归档和已验收盘口表。
服务切换与旧副本清退凭证保存在数据根目录的 `registry/` 和 `audits/`。

```{r}
root <- normalizePath(params$repository_root, mustWork = TRUE)
data_root <- normalizePath(params$data_root, mustWork = TRUE)
reticulate::use_python(normalizePath(params$python, mustWork = TRUE), required = TRUE)
storage <- reticulate::import_from_path("persistent_data_layout", file.path(root, "src"))
layout_check <- storage$check_layout(file.path(root, "config/persistent_data_layout.json"))
stopifnot(identical(data_root, layout_check$data_root))
layout_check$status
reference <- jsonlite::read_json(file.path(data_root, "registry/settlement-current.json"))
db_path <- file.path(data_root, reference$database)
stopifnot(file.exists(db_path))
stopifnot(identical(digest::digest(file = db_path, algo = "sha256"), reference$sha256))
source(file.path(root, "r/nowscore_query.R"))
x <- query_nowscore_settlement(db_path, "100213", play = "bf")
stopifnot(nrow(x$settlement) == 98L, !anyNA(x$settlement$sp))
```

## 表结构与前几行

```{r}
dplyr::glimpse(x$settlement)
head(x$settlement)
x$findings
```

更新前备份存放于 `settlement/backups/`，迁移凭证存放于 `settlement/manifests/`。
`registry/directory-layout-20260913.json` 保留此次文件迁移前后路径、大小和 SHA-256。
历史可用性仍标记为诊断用途，迁移不会改变数据的赛前可用性资格。

## 已验收盘口表

每行表示一期内一场比赛的一个市场记录。此发布保留此前已验收的100期合并表原始字节，
没有重新清洗、训练或调整验收尺度。

```{r}
markets <- jsonlite::read_json(file.path(data_root, "registry/markets-current.json"))
market_path <- file.path(data_root, markets$current_release$path)
stopifnot(identical(digest::digest(file = market_path, algo = "sha256"), markets$current_release$sha256))
merged <- jsonlite::fromJSON(market_path)
market_rows <- tibble::as_tibble(merged$rows)
stopifnot(nrow(market_rows) == merged$fixture_market_rows)
tibble::tibble(issues = length(merged$issues), fixture_market_rows = nrow(market_rows))
dplyr::glimpse(market_rows)
head(market_rows)
```

## 无损归档读取

外置盘的 exFAT 分配单元为 1MB，冻结的小文件批次使用 TAR/Zstandard 归档。
通过 Python 标准库读取所需成员，验证归档哈希，不产生解压目录。
以下示例将一条原始请求失败记录转换为 R object，验证失败证据也被完整保留。

```{r}
reticulate::use_python(normalizePath(params$python, mustWork = TRUE), required = TRUE)
archive_module <- reticulate::import_from_path("data_archive", file.path(root, "src"), convert = FALSE)
json_module <- reticulate::import("json", convert = FALSE)
archive_ref <- jsonlite::read_json(file.path(data_root, "fundamentals/manifests/historical-v1-read-check.json"))
payload <- archive_module$read_archive_members(
  file.path(data_root, archive_ref$archive),
  list(archive_ref$member), expected_sha256 = archive_ref$archive_sha256
)
raw_response <- reticulate::py_to_r(json_module$loads(payload$get(archive_ref$member)))
tibble::tibble(
  archive = archive_ref$archive,
  member = archive_ref$member,
  url = raw_response$url,
  transport_error = raw_response$error,
  response_fields = paste(names(raw_response), collapse = ", ")
)
```
